mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without requiring additional triggering conditions.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.5% for three consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate and increase in nonfarm payrolls indicates a tightening labor market that fuels wage growth and inflation expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE decline and PAYEMS increase fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), a decline in industrial production signals weakening economic activity, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, INDPRO declines do not produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the regime-specific signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (below 3.5%) consistently indicates a tight labor market that supports corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without additional conditions.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is negative in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1350 thousand units for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening housing market that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1350 fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of cases, or the Rank IC for the threshold signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicates an aggressive monetary policy response to inflation, which compresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong economic expansion (GDPC1 growth > 2.0% annualized), a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer spending, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 > 2.0%, RSAFS declines do not produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the regime-specific signal is below 0.03.
